column1: # drop.tsv: loader labels to delete from the data loader's symbol tables (asm/us/<table>/symbols.json) rather
# than rename (docs/code/NAMING.md section 5). Columns: name, table (blob, boot_tail, ovl_a, ovl_b; * = all four),
# note (the address, then why). A label is here when no map renames it, it is not already the right name of its
# address, and nothing uses it: no code line in src/ include/ port/ nonmatching/ besides extern declarations,
# prototypes and a #define of its own name, and no mention in tools/. Apply this file before the maps:
# gNumPlayers and gPauseState are dropped at their stale addresses and then given to the right ones.
# The rows after the "Interior labels" line are wave 2's (docs/code/NAMING.md 7 item 8): labels inside another object
# that the C now reads as the element or field of the object, dropped after the maps applied. Eighteen keep their
# line of symbol_addrs.us.txt (no symbol_addrs row here), without "renamed": no C reads them, but each ends the extent
# by gap of the object before it, as its C reference did, so data.c keeps every datum where it was:
